mapper.select: select cast(q.id as char) id, cast(q.supplier_id as char) supplierId, s.name supplierName, s.code supplierCode, q.name qualification, q.valid_until validUntil, datediff(q.valid_until, current_date) daysLeft from sp_supplier_qualification q join sp_supplier s on s.id=q.supplier_id where q.deleted=0 and s.deleted=0 and q.status<>'REVOKED' and q.valid_until is not null and q.valid_until <= date_add(current_date, interval #{windowDays} day) order by q.valid_until

select cast(o.id as char) id, o.order_no orderNo, s.name supplierName, o.status, o.delivery_date deliveryDate, datediff(o.delivery_date, current_date) daysLeft, o.total_amount totalAmount from po_purchase_order o join sp_supplier s on s.id=o.supplier_id where o.deleted=0 and o.status in ('APPROVED', 'PARTIALLY_RECEIVED') and o.delivery_date <= date_add(current_date, interval #{windowDays} day) order by o.delivery_date

select * from ( select 'REQUISITION' businessType, cast(r.id as char) id, r.requisition_no businessNo, r.budget_amount amount, timestampdiff(hour, r.updated_at, utc_timestamp()) waitingHours from pr_requisition r where r.deleted=0 and r.status='PENDING_APPROVAL' and r.updated_at <= utc_timestamp() - interval #{windowHours} hour union all select 'PURCHASE_ORDER', cast(o.id as char) id, o.order_no businessNo, o.total_amount amount, timestampdiff(hour, o.updated_at, utc_timestamp()) waitingHours from po_purchase_order o where o.deleted=0 and o.status='PENDING_APPROVAL' and o.updated_at <= utc_timestamp() - interval #{windowHours} hour ) pending order by waitingHours desc
